## DISKITIS AND VERTEBRAL OSTEOMYELITIS

When possible, obtain diagnostic cultures before starting empiric therapy.
Obtain blood cultures and image guided aspirates or surgical bone biopsy.
Definitive therapy is based on culture and susceptibility test results.

## Recommended duration of therapy:

Treat for at least 6 weeks of pathogen directed IV/PO therapy for high risk
including MRSA infection, ESRD, or undrained abscess or device implantation.
Once culture and susceptibility testing is available switch to pathogen directed
therapy.
____________________________________________
## Empiric therapy if patient is systemically ill:

Preferred:

_______________________________________________________________________________

## Inpatient

Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h [R] <AND> ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h [M]
Alternative:
Beta-lactam Reaction Assessment
Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h [R] <AND> ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q12h [R,DI]

_______________________________________________________________________________

## Outpatient

Refer to Inpatient Antimicrobial CDSS.
